milestones.title: Filed
milestones.joke: A pull request. Against your own app. Welcome to the job.
milestones.when: forgejo: you opened a PR against your own customer-portal repo

milestones.title: Shipped It
milestones.joke: Merged to main. The gate only let it through clean.
milestones.when: forgejo: your PR against your own customer-portal repo was merged

milestones.title: Contained
milestones.joke: The next probe comes back with nothing. That's the whole job, done.
milestones.when: soc: the bot's live re-probe against your customer-portal slot comes back empty

milestones.title: Patched
milestones.joke: One unit on the board: the fix is on main, and the gate said so.
milestones.when: your fix reached main (a merged PR on your customer-portal repo), or the swarm's re-probe came back empty

milestones.title: Never Breached
milestones.joke: The swarm tried the real payload and got nothing. It never landed once.
milestones.when: soc: the swarm's real attempt against your customer-portal slot failed, and no dump ever succeeded against it
